text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOSCALER_ALERT: attach failures increasing in europe-west1 GPU pool - quota deny on attach. Thread opened.
maria: seeing queue growth on inference-eu-west1, 95th latency jump, and a spike in 502s/504s.
aj: confirmed from autoscaler: repeated attach errors -> "googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for quota metric 'GPUS'". Backoff retries piling up.
sre_ellie: paging oncall @oncall-pager 1 - can you triage and stand the bridge up? Customers reporting slow responses.
oncall-pager: on it, will fetch attach logs + quota dashboards. ETA 4m.
incident-bot: Ops bridge created: #bridge-1769478888 (link)
infra-til: checked console - project infra-prod has GPUS quota at 100% in europe-west1; also hit organization fairshare ceiling for GPUs. No spare quota in sibling projects.
devops_sam: can we route inference traffic to another region temporarily (eu-north1 / us-central)? routing policy default prefers same-region, then nearest. Cross-region disabled for strict-prod tenants.
devops_lead: we need product approval for cross-region. Risk: data residency + latency.
product-lead: what's the minimal blast radius? can we do a whitelist for non-EU-restricted tenants only?
maria: yes, we can create a tenant whitelist. Impact right now: ~9% requests queued >6s, errors ~4%, affecting a handful of enterprise customers.
aj: autoscaler log excerpt:
```
W0707 10:12:33 autoscaler.go:456] AttachInstance failed: googleapi: Error 403: Quota exceeded for quota metric 'GPUS' and limit 'GPUS' for consumer 'projects/infra-prod'., quotaExceeded
```
infra-til: warm pool in eu-west1 currently cold due to recent maintenance, so scaling warmers won't help until quota freed.
oncall-pager: mitigation plan (proposed):
- immediately enable cross-region failover for tenant-set: non-restricted-prod (PATCH routing)
- kill or pause background batch/retraining jobs in eu-west1 to free GPUs
- submit emergency quota increase request to GCP with justification and usage graphs
- monitor attach success rate and queue depth; if errors persist >5m escalate to pagerduty

devops_sam: pausing 2 retrain jobs (job-9981, job-9942) now.
infra-til: after pausing batch, freed 5 GPUs from pool. Attempting reattach.
aj: reattempts show attach successes improving: failures down from 80% -> 30%. Still some attach denies due to org-level fairshare.
customer-ops: drafting an alert to affected customers: short message + status + mitigation. Will share for review.
product-lead: approve cross-region for non-restricted tenants. Please whitelist tenant-group `non_eu_prod`.
devops_lead: applying routing change: PATCH /api/v1/routing/failover {"tenant_group":"non_eu_prod","allow_regions":["eu-north1","us-central1"]}
incident-bot: routing change deployed. Observing traffic shift - about 25% of queued requests rerouted off eu-west1.
maria: queue depth dropping, tail latency improving. Error rate trending down.
aj: opened GCP support ticket ID: 9876543210 with priority P0, submitted justification & billing confirmation.
incident-bot: support ticket 9876543210 acknowledged by GCP; initial response ETA 90m.
infra-til: GCP indicated org-level fairshare may still prevent immediate attach for some requests until quota reassigns. We should avoid draining warm pool.
noncall-pager: deployed temporary autoscaler config: increase attach timeout to 45s and reduce concurrent attach burst to 2 to reduce contention.
aj: after config change, attach success rate improved further; queue nearly back to baseline for non-whitelisted tenants.
customer-ops: customer draft posted in #customer-ops-drafts. Key line: "We27re experiencing elevated latency in EU region; partial traffic rerouting in effect for non-EU restricted customers."
product-lead: ensure EU-only tenants were not routed.
maria: verified EU-only tenants unaffected - no cross-border traffic for those IDs.
devops_lead: follow ups needed:
- permanent alert when GPUS quota >85% in any region
- review batch scheduling to prevent batch + peak inference overlap
- evaluate reserved capacity for key customers in eu-west1

oncall-pager: handing off to @oncall-next in 20m. State: routing fallback active for `non_eu_prod`, GCP ticket open, batch jobs paused, attach success rate improving.
oncall-next: ack. I27ll monitor ticket updates and attach metrics.
aj: GCP support updated: can grant temporary +8 GPUs for 2 hours after billing confirmation. They requested exact CPU/GPU SKU list and justification.
infra-til: sending SKU list and 90th/95th percentile token/sec metrics. Recommended +8 GPUs to restore buffer.
aj: submitted billing confirmation. GCP started quota push; attach in progress.
incident-bot: quota change in progress - expected attach completion ~12m.
customer-ops: sent customer notice to impacted list; support channels prepped with templates.
sre_ellie: incident summary: root cause = region GPUS quota + org fairshare exhausted causing autoscaler attach denies -> queue growth and higher tail latency. Temporary mitigations: routing whitelist for non-EU tenants, pause batch jobs, tweak autoscaler attach settings, emergency quota request.
product-lead: schedule postmortem and capacity planning review tomorrow.
oncall-next: taking over monitoring. Will annotate bridge notes and update postmortem template.
maria: returning to watch metrics; will add timeline and logs to postmortem doc when bridge closes. Thanks team. :heart:
